channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Want to build an AI operating model? First, build consensus
item.description: The best AI leaders—whether COOs, CAIOs, or CIOs—possess an old-fashioned skill set: building consensus across teams.

item.title: Exclusive: AWS Marketplace head on letting AI agents shop for software: “People can’t wait three months to get access to the latest one”
item.description: AWS Marketplace lets companies give AI agents a budget to buy software products.

item.title: Crypto platform’s plan to offer tokenized shares for Anthropic IPO comes up short, following similar SpaceX flop
item.description: Crypto tokens can give investors a shot at the IPO price, but strong demand keeps leaving platforms short of shares.

item.title: Verizon’s CEO knows Elon Musk is coming for his business. He says it’ll cost SpaceX over $300 billion to compete
item.description: “There's no secret sauce, there's no magic wand, there's no structural cost advantage that will come out,” Dan Schulman told Fortune.
